# Design Package validator

`design-package.mjs` is an unchanged local copy of the validator supplied with the installed `rea-design-transfer` skill, version1.0.3, sourced from the installed skill's `scripts/design-package.mjs`.

Upstream package: https://github.com/ECdison6227/rea-design-transfer . It is retained here so this design package can be verified without the original machine's absolute skill path. It validates declarations and hashes; it does not certify screenshots, licenses, or original business behavior.
